title: Бытие 18 — Genesis 18
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Господь явился ___ у великих деревьев Мамре.
cases.translation: The Lord appeared to Abraham by the great trees of Mamre.
cases.explain: The verb явиться (to appear to someone) takes the person in the dative → Аврааму.
В marking a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → шатре.

cases.sentence: Он стоял рядом с ними под ___.
cases.translation: He stood beside them under the tree.
cases.explain: The preposition под marking location (under) takes the instrumental → деревом.

cases.sentence: Есть ли что-нибудь слишком трудное для ___?
cases.translation: Is anything too hard for the Lord?
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) takes the genitive → Господа.

cases.sentence: Он побежал к стаду, выбрал лучшего нежного ___.
cases.translation: He ran to the herd and picked out a good, tender calf.
cases.explain: Direct object of выбрал (picked out); for animate masculine nouns the accusative equals the genitive → телёнка.

cases.sentence: Авраам поспешил в шатер к ___ и сказал.
cases.translation: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah and said…
cases.explain: The preposition к (to / toward) takes the dative → Саре.

cases.translation: The Lord remained standing before Abraham.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before / in front of) takes the instrumental → Авраамом.

cases.translation: Sarah your wife will have a son.
cases.explain: Сын is the subject of будет (there will be), so it takes the nominative → сын.

reading.ru: Господь явился Аврааму у великих деревьев Мамре, когда он сидел у входа в свой шатер во время дневного зноя.
reading.question: Where and when did the Lord appear to Abraham?
options: By the trees of Mamre, in the heat of the day
reading.correct: By the trees of Mamre, in the heat of the day
reading.explain: The Lord appeared by the great trees of Mamre while Abraham sat at his tent door in the day's heat.

reading.ru: Авраам поднял взгляд и увидел, что неподалеку стоят три человека.
reading.question: What did Abraham see when he looked up?
reading.explain: Abraham lifted his eyes and saw three men standing near him.

reading.ru: Затем он побежал к стаду, выбрал лучшего нежного теленка и отдал слуге, который быстро приготовил его.
reading.question: What did Abraham prepare for his guests from the herd?
reading.explain: Abraham ran to the herd, chose a good, tender calf, and had a servant prepare it.

reading.ru: Тогда Господь сказал, «Я непременно вернусь к тебе в следующем году, примерно в это же время, и у Сары твоей жены будет сын».
reading.question: What did the Lord promise Abraham?
options: Sarah would have a son the next year
He would destroy Sodom at once
reading.correct: Sarah would have a son the next year
reading.explain: The Lord said He would return about that time next year, and Sarah would have a son.

reading.ru: Поэтому Сара рассмеялась про себя, подумав, «Я уже состарилась, и господин мой стар, мне ли иметь еще такую радость?»
reading.question: Why did Sarah laugh to herself?
options: She thought she and Abraham were too old for a child
She was overjoyed by the guests
She did not believe the men were real
She was afraid of the Lord
reading.correct: She thought she and Abraham were too old for a child
reading.explain: Sarah laughed inwardly because she and her husband were old and past the age of childbearing.

reading.ru: Если я найду в Содоме пятьдесят праведников, то пощажу ради них все это место.
reading.question: What did the Lord say He would do if He found fifty righteous people in Sodom?
options: Spare the whole place for their sake
reading.correct: Spare the whole place for their sake
reading.explain: The Lord promised to spare the entire city if fifty righteous people were found in it.
